description:
A tribute to the hardworking farmers of Pakistan by Sarsabz Fertilizers. Let’s celebrate Kissan Day on 18th December Nationwide and thank them for taking care of the food security of our country. Share your tribute using #SalamKissan #SarsabzPakistan #KissanDay

Video Director: Jami
Singer: Mai Dhai & Shani Arshad 
Music Composition: Shani Arshad
Lyricist: Sabir Zafar
Concept: Saima Saleem
Production House: Azadfilm
fulltitle: Salam Kissan 2021 | Kissan Day | A Tribute to Farmers by Sarsabz Fertilizers
